Who runs this site

The site is maintained by Good Vibes Va'a, an outrigger canoe club at Praia da Preguiça, in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil. Support is handled by the club's team through the channels listed on the contact page.

What the site offers

Information about the club's experiences, booking and quote requests, contact with the team, and a presentation of the club's product line. The site does not process payments at this time: every booking is confirmed by the team before any charge.

Information subject to confirmation

Times, prices, available seats and conditions depend on the sea and on the club's schedule, and are confirmed by the team for each booking. Anything shown before that confirmation is indicative.

Use of content and brandto be defined

Conditions for third-party use of Good Vibes Va'a photographs, texts and brand — the club still needs to define what is allowed (for example, use by partners, press and members on social media).

Responsibility in the sportto be defined

Outrigger canoeing is a physical activity in open water. Participation requirements, the liability waiver signed before each outing, health requirements and insurance coverage must be defined by the club and legally reviewed before becoming public text.

Sign-up and personal data

Personal data handling is described in the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

Changes to these termsto be defined

How and with how much notice the club may change these conditions — to be defined.

Applicable law and jurisdictionto be defined

Applicable law and the jurisdiction for resolving disputes — to be defined with legal support.

While this document is marked as a draft, it does not constitute terms of use in force. For questions about participation, conditions or liability, talk to the team through the contact page.
